snippet.title: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
SpeedRunners are back! A sequel is coming to PC in 2025 and consoles in 2026.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183760/Speedrunners_2_King_of_Speed/

The follow-up to one of the most beloved indie sensations of the last decade, this fast-paced multiplayer platformer features completely new challenges and the same high-stakes action fans love.

In SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed, you will be able to:
🏃 Compete in online or local runs for up to 8 players
🏃 Knock rivals off-screen and eliminate your foes with powerful pick-ups like missiles, traps, freeze rays, and a grappling hook
🏃 Experience the thrill and fluidity of the original game but in vibrant high-definition graphics

The original award-winning SpeedRunners, released in 2016, has grown into a party game hit with a thriving community and over 10 million players since launch. Dubbed the ‘Mario Kart of 2D platformers,’ it still has an active tournament scene going strong today.

🏁  🏁  🏁
